jobs.details: O poslodavcu Machine Learning Engineer Novi Sad Your future field of work We are launching a set of new AI projects designed to deliver immediate, tangible value to our users. Just as importantly, we are building internal AI tooling to improve our software development processes and help our engineers build more effectively. This initiative involves projects spanning local LLMs, RAG systems, multi-agent workflows, and the semantic analysis of our engineering data. What we don't have yet is a team that properly owns this. That's the job. You will be the senior engineer in the room from day one: setting the technical direction, deciding what we build versus what we buy, and helping us hire the people who come next. Your role would include: Designing, building, and shipping machine learning solutions that run in embedded and real-time environments Taking models the whole way: data, training, optimization, integration, deployment, and the unglamorous monitoring afterwards. Establishing the foundational MLOps infrastructure Tailoring models for constrained targets (quantization, pruning) and making honest trade-offs between accuracy, memory, and latency Working across diverse domains and business units (embedded, DTV, Android, IoT, automotive, CI/CD). Their constraints are your constraints, and most of your design decisions will be made in conversation with them. Turning advanced AI concepts into practical tools. You will build RAG systems and multi-agent workflows to solve real bottlenecks in daily engineering work. Defining what we need, interviewing candidates, and establishing the engineering standards, tooling, and review practices the team will work by Providing structured engineering mentorship and helping us turn interns into colleagues Communication with stakeholders across the company. Part of the job is explaining what AI can realistically do for a given product and being equally clear about what it can't. jobs.title: Online Data Analyst - Serbian (RS)
jobs.summary: This role exists to verify and validate spatial and business data to ensure mapping accuracy and user-safe navigation. The contributor performs structured audits and root cause analyses and provides feedback that improves geographic intelligence and reduces real-world navigation errors.
jobs.details: TELUS Digital AI Community Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and contribute to the development of innovative AI technologies used by some of the world's largest brands. Millions of people rely on digital maps every day to navigate, discover, and find their way. But maps are only as accurate as the data behind them, and data is only as trustworthy as the people who verify it. Your knowledge of Serbia's geography, local landmarks, and how people actually navigate your region is something no algorithm can fully replicate. That local intelligence is what makes maps genuinely useful. A Day in the Life of an Online Data Analyst In this role, you will conduct structured quality audits on spatial and mapping datasets. Your role is to verify, evaluate, and validate complex geographic and business information using advanced mapping tools and detailed reference materials. Conduct structured quality audits on spatial datasets using mapping platforms, search directories, and GIS-standard evaluation tools Evaluate and cross-reference complex business, geographic, and cultural data entries against multiple authoritative sources Perform root-cause analysis when spatial data points conflict across sources, documenting the discrepancy with precise reasoning Apply detailed evaluation frameworks with consistency and rigor across dozens of geographic, business, and cultural data variations Be open to working across a diverse set of task types, e.g. Maps, News, Audio tasks, Relevance Provide structured feedback that helps refine mapping algorithms and improve geographic intelligence Reference: 6WaymiPCTY1SKkX-nbAuakxlQAIdD8fZwBDKP97n92YDD8AZYsasWakzvGP7DpVD Why this matters: accurately verified mapping data prevents real-world navigation errors. Your verification work ensures people can reliably find critical services, reach trusted businesses, and navigate with confidence. At scale, this is infrastructure work that is foundational to how billions of people interact with geographic information. Why join the project: Fully remote flexibility: complete work from anywhere with stable internet, structuring your schedule around academic research, consulting, or other professional commitments Structured onboarding: access comprehensive evaluation guidelines, detailed reference materials, and practical examples before your first live assessment Direct feedback and growth: receive performance assessments tied to quality metrics so you can refine your evaluation precision Intellectually rigorous work: each evaluation requires methodical reasoning, framework interpretation, and structured discrepancy analysis Responsive support team: contact dedicated contributor operations staff for clarification on guidelines, technical issues, or administrative questions Requirements: Professional fluency in English and Serbian, Latin and Cyrillic script, native or near-native proficiency required Access to both Cyrillic and Latin keyboards is required Being open to working across a diverse set of task types, e.g. Maps, News, Audio tasks, Relevance Advanced analytical thinking and methodical problem-solving ability Deep regional, cultural, and geographic knowledge of Serbia Comfort with rigorous guideline interpretation and consistent framework application Bachelor's degr

We're looking for a Project Manager to join our Belgrade office and work alongside our in-house development team, owning the flow of work from planning through to production release. You'll be the link between the developers and our game integration partners, the person who keeps the board clean, spots what's stuck, and makes sure the right issue reaches the right person. Location: Belgrade full-time, on-site Employment: Full employment contract with mandatory social contributions. What You'll Do Planning & Task Management Track the development team's work in Jira and keep the Kanban board current and readable. Create and detail tasks, write the context and acceptance criteria so a developer can pick the ticket up and start without coming back with questions. Maintain an Agile working rhythm and keep the team inside it. Set priorities: decide what can wait and what needs to go into the team now. Testing & Release Track work through the test environment and make sure testing is actually completed, not just assigned. Plan and coordinate production releases. Write and distribute release notes to the relevant stakeholders. Keep Jira and Confluence records up to date – process documentation is yours to own. Integration Partners Stay in regular contact with our game integration partners. Understand incoming issues and route them to the technical team with the right context, then follow through on both sides. Team & Reporting Keep communication inside the team constructive and the working atmosphere good. Report regularly on delivery status and team performance. What We're Looking For Required At least 2 years in project management or a comparable role. Hands-on Jira experience: managing a Kanban board and writing well-specified tickets. Solid working understanding of Agile practices. Strong written and spoken communication, with a respectful and collaborative tone. English at a level that lets you correspond confidently with integration partners. Organised, consistent working habits and care for the shared office environment. Note: We are not expecting advanced software knowledge. Strong logical thinking and the ability to follow a technical conversation will make this role considerably easier for you. Nice to have Experience in iGaming or a comparable live product. Turkish language skills. Familiarity with game providers or payment integration processes. General familiarity with software development workflow, APIs, test environments, deployment. Experience with Confluence or similar documentation tools.
